requests_made.purpose: retrieve the site's own music-category-filtered programme listing (categoria=musica is the source's own query parameter, not invented here)
requests_made.retained_fixture: fixtures/teatro-municipal-porto/programa-musica-setembro-excerpt.html (bounded excerpt: the first article's data-value="Setembro 2026" group, first 4 of its live grid-items)

requests_made.purpose: venue address evidence (Rivoli) for venues/porto.json (not an Observation acquisition request)

findings.structure: Each <article data-value="Month YYYY"> groups that month's <div class="grid-item" id="p_{slug}"> cards. No numeric id is rendered anywhere on this listing; the slug from the card's own id/permalink is the only source-derived identifier available, so it is used as source_record_id (a documented judgement call, not independently re-verified for long-term stability the way Village Underground's ICS UID was).
findings.date_time: Each card exposes one or more '.horario-item' occurrences: a day-of-month ('.dia_dia') and an HH:MM time ('.hora'), with month/year supplied only by the containing article's own data-value attribute, not repeated per-card. Some cards genuinely list more than one dated occurrence (e.g. Fri 18 + Sat 19 Set) for the same programme entry — handled the same way AgendaLX's recurring-occurrence series are handled: one Observation per card, start = the first occurrence, full occurrence list preserved honestly in source_fields.occurrences, end left empty.
findings.venue_identity: A '.local-p' venue-name span (e.g. 'Rivoli') plus an optional '.sep' sub-location (e.g. 'Praça D. João I') is repeated per card — genuinely multi-venue, unlike Casa da Música. Only 'Rivoli' is explicitly resolved in this proof (venues/porto.json); off-site locations such as 'Biblioteca Municipal Almeida Garrett' are deliberately left UNRESOLVED, mirroring the Odivelas 'Fado na Rua' precedent in docs/VENUE_RESOLUTION.md.
findings.music_filter: This fixture was retrieved through the site's own ?categoria=musica query parameter, so every retained record is already source-classified as music — no separate genre inference was added by this project.
